pinned_sources.license_note: The required g711.c, g721.c, g72x.c, and g72x.h components grant unrestricted use, copying, and modification without charge, with warranty and liability disclaimers; their complete notice is retained in every language port. The CLI adapter is not copied.

contract.operation: Encode a bounded sequence of u-law bytes with the pinned source's G.721 4-bit adaptive differential PCM state machine.
contract.state_initialization: Reset the G.721 state to yl=34816, yu=544, zero predictor and adaptation fields, and 32-valued quantized history fields on every call.
contract.packing: First 4-bit code occupies the low nibble; the next occupies the high nibble. An odd final code is padded by a zero high nibble.
contract.zero_count: Returns zero without output writes; a null output pointer is accepted.

input.encoding: sample count followed by u-law bytes

source_bound.description: The launcher defaults to u-law input and G.721 4-bit codes. This profile keeps u-law linearization, G.721 difference quantization, adaptive predictor and scale updates, per-call initial state, and low-nibble-first packing.
source_bound.excluded_work: G.723 24/40-kbit variants, A-law and linear input modes, decoding, file input, and timing are outside this package.
source_bound.distinctness: G.721's two-pole/six-zero predictor and adaptive logarithmic scale state differ from the local IMA/DVI codec's scalar predictor and step-index update.
source_bound.provenance: Pinned lac-dcc/Benchmarks MediaBench G.721 launcher at 5d7b75df749241efa7a6e6f5be613d3fcc5cce38. The required codec components carry Sun Microsystems' unrestricted-use notice, copied in full into each port; the CLI adapter's behavior is independently implemented.
